company.name: Bonfire Studios, Inc.

company.hq: Irvine, California, United States (hybrid; staff also in Canada and New Zealand)

people_spec: Technical Director (affected leader, not the buyer)
talk_track: I spent two years building the shared technical-operations layer under four Prytania Media studios — DevOps, build/release, IT, security, vendors — so the Tech Directors never had to touch it. Your live Systems Engineer (Principal/Lead) posting lists "optimizing iteration pipelines" next to netcode and rendering, at a $263,750-$320,000 base, and your Internal Tools PM posting tells candidates it may not be the role if "you want lots of process and structure already in place." Read together in the same week Arkheron's closed beta is running as a technical test across PC and Xbox, those two postings say the operational foundation is being spread across your most expensive engineering hires instead of being owned. At Prytania I found a tech director running builds out of zip files; putting one owner on that pipeline landed the prototype milestone six weeks early, ahead of investor demos. That layer is cheap to own on purpose and expensive to own by accident. Who owns builds, cloud, and access at Bonfire today?
